native_mechanisms: Strictly serial folding: one crease per mark, each crease's angle determined by both the mark and the immediately preceding crease, never skipping or looking ahead.

Per-crease four-gauge consensus: press each crease against all four wire birds' beaks at once and refold tighter until all four agree, with the markings deliberately scrambled so distinct piles can't coincide.
Final thinning at the water's edge: compress the whole folded wad (plus the small suitcase = length) into one dense coin-sized corner and discard every sheet, scrap and failed reading.
core_technique: A near-verbatim xxHash64: four interleaved 64-bit lanes of add-multiply-rotate-multiply over 32-byte blocks, asymmetric rotate-and-add lane merge, length added, 8/4/1-byte tail rounds, then a standard multiply-xorshift (Murmur-style) avalanche finalizer.
